Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: success E_ NOTOK: Tx - statistics could not be obtained Description Returns the list of Transmission Statistics out of IETF RFC1213 defined with Eth_ Tx Stats Type, where the maximal possible value shall denote an invalid value, e.g. this counter is not available. Available via Eth If.h
